text:
Maiya: quick brainstorming: propose a lightweight 'fastgate' validator for model intake. single-shot CI harness to catch obvious tokenizer/regressions, basic perf, quant parity, and sentinel-token sanity before scheduling full smoke runs.
Vikram: sounds useful. target latency/cost?
Maiya: aim <10s wall, <0.2 GPU-min on cache hits. runs on tiny-pool (one small GPU or CPU path). skip re-quant when registry has prequantized artifact.
Oliver: sampling plan? long seqs often reveal issues.
Maiya: default seqlens = [8,256,2048]; if declared max_seq >2048 include that. single forward per seqlen, deterministic decode (seed=42, temp=0, top_k=1), short decode length to bound cost.
Sasha: tokenizer diffs cause noisy fails.
Maiya: two-stage comparator: (1) token-level checks: tokenizer checksum, special-token presence, token-count sanity; (2) semantic fallback: n-gram overlap + embedding cosine on a 12-item golden prompts set. fail only if both indicate problem OR tokenization emits truncated/malformed outputs.
Vikram: quant parity?
Maiya: compare float and available quant variants (q4,q8) when present. compute token-match rate and embed cosine. PASS if embed_cosine>=0.92 or token_match>=0.9, otherwise flag for smokehouse.
Danielle: CI/cost concerns + caching?
Maiya: CI job fetches model-registry cache; quant step skipped when cached. emit cache_hit flag in fingerprint. example fingerprint string embedded in artifact:
`fastgate_fp: sha256:abcd...,seqlens:[8,256,2048],perf_ms:{8:5,256:38,2048:210},token_match:0.95,embed_cosine:0.96,cache_hit:true`
ci-bot: validator-fastgate triggered for PR #812 on tiny-pool :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Vikram: telemetry hooks: publish token-lat p50/p95 per seqlen + peak memory estimate so platform can tune reserves.
Sasha: add sentinel token id stability check (eos,bos,pad,unk) and fail on missing/changed ids.
Maiya: added. failure flow: label PR `fastgate:fail` + attach fingerprint and small diff summary; owners triage. add `fastgate:ignore-ttl` label for temporary ignores with expiration.
Oliver: can we expose quick rollback that pins prior quant artifact when perf blips?
Maiya: yes, intake pipeline will offer one-click rollback to previous stable quantized binary until owner fixes.
Danielle: I'll wire the CI triggers and artifact cache. Maiya: will push a prototype CLI: `validator-fastgate run --manifest manifest.json --gold goldset.json --out fp.json`. tagging @Oliver for seqlen/threshold review.
Oliver: will review later today. :eyes:
